faq.q: Will I buy the vignette in the app?
faq.a: No. {name} builds the plan and sends you to each country's official shop. That's the design goal.
The first version aims at European countries that use vignettes. The full list will be set before launch.
Subscriptions will be managed through the App Store and Google Play, and can be cancelled any time.
